where does plastic go at hku.answer:
Based on the official HKU recycling documents, here is the answer:

Bin category: Plastic recycling bin

Accepted plastic items include PET plastic drink bottles, clean plastic packaging, plastic bags, and plastic takeaway containers (if rinsed clean). Plastic must be clean and dry. [recycling_101#7]

Supporting details: Plastic bottles are accepted at most Smart Recycling Bins except at Central Podium Levels and Pine Court, which accept other plastics instead. [recycling_101#7]

where can i recycle glass bottles on cam.answer:
Based on the official HKU recycling documents, here is the answer:

Bin category: Glass recycling point (re Kiosk or designated glass bin)

Glass bottles are accepted at the re Kiosk and at the Smart Recycling Bins located at G/F, Central Podium Levels (Centennial Campus) and Pine Court. [recycling_101#6]

Supporting details: Only clean glass bottles are recycled. Rinse glass bottles before recycling. Do not break the glass. [recycling_101#6]
